text: The Patriots look to keep their winning streak alive at two games when they host the 2-3 Jets in an AFC East divisional matchup at Gillette Stadium on Sunday, a game Jets receiver Garrett Wilson has called a "big-ass game" for New York's playoff hopes. Drake Maye earned FedEx Air & Ground Player of the Week honors following his Week 5 performance, and the quarterback addressed the media Wednesday ahead of the crucial divisional clash, though the Patriots will need to navigate some injury concerns on both sides of the ball: left tackle Will Campbell is sidelined with an MCL sprain in his right knee, running back TreVeyon Henderson is expected to miss multiple weeks with a high ankle sprain, but cornerback Christian Gonzalez indicated he's "ready to go" after missing the past two games with a shoulder injury and has returned to practice, along with wide receiver Brown. The Patriots' defensive gameplan will need to account for the Jets' blitz-heavy approach, and oddsmakers apparently agree the matchup favors New England—ESPN's NFL survivor pool rankings list the Patriots among the top options for Week 6 alongside the Rams and Colts.
